retrieved.title: Expense Tracker scheduled report emails not sending
retrieved.description: [TCK-38821] Ticket raised because the scheduled report emails from Expense Tracker have silently stopped going out and users are not receiving their daily summaries. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: The outbound mail worker for Expense Tracker had a stuck queue after an SMTP change; updated the mailer settings, drained the queue, and confirmed reports resumed.
